description: [$x402 pay-per-call] Generates between 1 and 100 ULIDs (timestamp + cryptographic randomness).

count.description: Number of ULIDs to generate (1-100). Default: 1.

x_payment.description: Optional. Signed x402 payment header (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT) from the caller. If omitted, returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements.

name: dev_tools_ulid_generate
